# Changelog

## v0.2

- Added arena mark/pop and zero push.
- Added glyph transform module.
- Added static text layout and shaped text rendering.
- Added SVG path subset importer.
- Added bitmap OR blitter.
- Expanded demo and GFF roundtrip check.

## v0.1

- Initial C89/no-heap fixed-point font core.
- Lines, quadratic outlines, closed contours.
- 1-bit rasterizer, static atlas, SVG writer, GFF export/import.
- Small shaping plan, HarfBuzz-like facade, FreeType-like facade, tiny hint VM.
